The existing lab has 40 PCs across ten IPv4 LANs, connected by eight routers with static routes. A central DNS service can use those existing routes without changing the links.

Here is the proposed specification:

- Run BIND on an existing, centrally located machine, `pc21` (`10.15.6.11`), using its current `kathara/base` image.
- Configure all 40 PCs to use that DNS server. Keep their existing addresses, gateways, links, and static routing.
- Serve these internal DNS records:

| Name | Machine | IPv4 address |
|---|---|---|
| shop.example.com | pc16 | 10.15.4.14 |
| blog.example.com | pc17 | 10.15.5.11 |
| dept.company.com | pc18 | 10.15.5.12 |
| intranet.company.com | pc19 | 10.15.5.13 |
| api.service.com | pc20 | 10.15.5.14 |
| ai.research.lab.net | pc22 | 10.15.6.12 |
| data.research.lab.net | pc23 | 10.15.6.13 |
| dev.lab.net | pc24 | 10.15.6.14 |
| ci.tools.net | pc25 | 10.15.7.11 |
| vpn.university.edu | pc26 | 10.15.7.12 |
| courses.university.edu | pc27 | 10.15.7.13 |
| portal.campus.edu | pc28 | 10.15.7.14 |
| studenti.unibo.it | pc29 | 10.15.8.11 |
| servizi.comune.it | pc30 | 10.15.8.12 |
| dati.regione.it | pc31 | 10.15.8.13 |
| mail.company.com | pc7 | 10.15.2.13 |
| mail.university.edu | pc11 | 10.15.3.13 |

Add MX records for `company.com` and `university.edu`, each pointing to its respective mail hostname. These records identify the mail destinations; they do not themselves install or configure mail servers. The DNS zones would be authoritative inside the lab, so these names would resolve to the lab addresses there.

After implementation, validation should check the DNS configuration, resolve every A and MX record from PCs on different LANs, and check representative cross-network connectivity. Runtime validation would be performed when requested.

Would you like me to implement this specification?

The [Kathara creation skill](/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-lqaxoc4z/lab/.codex/skills/kathara-creation/SKILL.md) explicitly says: “Only start creating files after the user asks to create the scenario starting from the generated prompt.” I have therefore prepared the specification and have not modified the lab.
